notes:
Account background: Questline Apps (mid-market SaaS) builds a conversational product for SMBs (customer onboarding + support). Currently on Provider X for chat + embeddings; experiencing rising costs and variable latency. Evaluating Redwood Hosted for quick parity then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost.

Recent rep interactions: AE Maya Chen owns the account; SE Victor Alvarez supporting technical POC; CSM Hannah Reed onboarded for handover planning. CTO comment on 2026-02-18 call: "We need drop-in compatibility for existing API calls — minimal app changes."

Technical constraints / asks:
- Must preserve prompt/response parity (same few-shot prompts + system instructions).
- Reranking pipeline currently uses Provider X embeddings + reranker; want embedded parity and reranker accuracy within +/-2% F1.
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms for chat on hosted during demo; production Dedicated target p95 < 120ms for baseline model.
- Throughput: steady-state 120 concurrent sessions, bursts to 600 qps for batch jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: tight unit-cost targets; finance wants projected TCO for 12/24 month committed Dedicated.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2-level controls, audit logs retained 1 year, optional customer KMS for encryption keys, data residency for EU customers.

POC / migration plan (high-level):
1) Hosted parity POC (2 weeks) — one endpoint mapping layer that translates Provider X schema to Redwood API; run traffic shadowing on 10% of requests.
2) Prompt parity validation — run side-by-side eval harness on 2k customer prompts (golden set). Track regression metrics and qualitative review.
3) Reranker compatibility — validate embeddings similarity; if mismatch, test Redwood Optimize quantization/profile recommendations.
4) Performance smoke tests — verify latency/throughput targets on Hosted.
5) Dedicated sizing exercise — Redwood to propose GPU pool config and committed monthly throughput.
6) Canary migrate: route 5% production traffic to Dedicated in same region with fallback to Hosted.

POC status / findings so far:
- Hosted demo (2026-02-18): good baseline latency, minor differences in completion tokenization (affects post-processing).
- Eval run (2026-03-03): 2k prompt suite ran; 38 examples flagged as regressions (mostly on numeric extraction + code formatting).
- Reranker: cosine similarity with Redwood embeddings shows mean delta 0.04 vs Provider X; exploratory tuning on embedding model and reranker threshold reduced false negatives by 60% in lab.
- Compatibility layer: initial shim implemented by Questline infra team; required mapping of "conversation_id" and header names, plus converting Provider X function-calling schema to Redwood function metadata.

Open technical risks:
- Prompt parity: few-shot templates rely on tokenization quirks; may need micro-prompt edits or post-processing changes.
- Regression acceptance criteria not fully agreed (product wants "no user-visible regressions").
- Dedicated SLA vs cost — tradeoff: to meet p95 < 120ms need N larger GPU footprint which increases commit.

Commercials / pricing conversation:
- Questline asked for two proposals: (A) 12-month Dedicated commit sized for steady-state (lower commit, higher overage), (B) 24-month aggressive commit for better unit pricing.
- Finance asked for a TCO comparison Hosted vs Dedicated (12/24 mo) with break-even analysis. Redwood to provide detailed token-level model mix and projected savings.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-08: Intro call with Maya, Victor, CTO (scope & constraints).
- 2026-02-18: Hosted demo (ff-2026-02-18-ql-demo).
- 2026-02-22: Questline shared golden prompts + reranker test set (drive link).

- 2026-03-09: Price sheet v1 delivered; Questline follow-up questions (thread-CA+qk3=20260309-pricing).
- 2026-03-10: Handoff prep with CSM; plan for Dedicated sizing call next week.

Acceptance criteria for moving to Dedicated:
- Regression rate <= 1.5% on golden prompt set with no critical user-facing failures.
- Embedding similarity / reranker accuracy within agreed thresholds (F1 delta <= 2%).
- Verified latency p95 < 120ms under production-like load in Dedicated staging.
- Commercial terms agreed (commit and overage caps).

Short-term next steps:
- Victor to run targeted prompt-tuning on 38 regression cases and share diff by 2026-03-14.
- Redwood product to provide Dedicated sizing + cost scenarios by 2026-03-16.
- Schedule canary plan/rollout doc and runbook; share with Questline infra for review.
